tagline: Six synthetic projects, including a capstone. Reproducible code checks and written engineering comparisons; independent review pending.

milestones.title: Neural Signal Viewer
milestones.shortDescription: Describe a sampled signal with units and separate threshold samples from inferred biological events.

milestones.title: Spike Detector + Feature Vector
milestones.shortDescription: Group threshold excursions and explain what a global statistical threshold can and cannot establish.

milestones.title: Noise Smoother & Drift Corrector
milestones.shortDescription: Implement a causal rolling baseline estimate and quantify its edge and waveform distortion.

milestones.title: Weighted Linear Decoder
milestones.shortDescription: Fit an inspectable two-class linear rule using training data only and keep the held-out result separate.

milestones.title: Cursor Simulator + Latency
milestones.shortDescription: Reproduce a delayed-feedback trajectory and distinguish model time from execution time.

milestones.title: Closed-Loop BCI Capstone
milestones.shortDescription: Reproduce a bounded synthetic pipeline and trace how preprocessing, detection and decoding affect its cursor output.
